Every pelican that tried to ride a bicycle

>Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

Since October 2024 Simon Willison has fed that exact prompt to nearly every new model and posted the result. attempts from labs are collected here, from the first grey oval with a banana beak to yesterday's GPT-6 Astra comparison grid. Drag the slider or scroll the road to ride through time.

How the drawings improved

Each dot is one attempt. Height is a 1 to 5 reading of Simon's write-up (my scoring, not his; he doesn't grade them). Tap a dot to see it.

All attempts

Images, verdicts and dates come from Simon Willison's pelican-riding-a-bicycle tag (141 posts as of 5 Sep 2026); the pre-2026 ordering leans on OpenClaw's pelican timeline. Verdict text is paraphrased from Simon's commentary. Thumbnails are embedded; each entry links to the original image and post. Where a post showed several pelicans (reasoning levels, quantisations) the one Simon singled out is shown.
